definition_zh: 兄弟情谊；弟兄团体，兄弟会；同业组织
definition_en: the bond between brothers; a group of men, or people generally, united by a common aim or faith
core_image: 并肩的手臂搭在一起，结成一个圈子
scene: 结社的旧厅里，新成员把手按在章程上。The union built its brotherhood on shared hardship.
sceneCN: 这里 brotherhood 是「同业组织、会社」（第 3 个义项：因共同目标而结合的团体）；句意是工会把组织建立在共患难之上。

pos.zh: 兄弟情谊；弟兄关系；兄弟会；同业组织

derivatives.zh: brotherhood 的基础词，义为「兄弟」
由 brother 加 -ly 构成，义为「兄弟般的」
平行词，义为「姐妹情谊；妇女团体」

senses.title: The bond between brothers
senses.definition: the affection and loyalty felt between brothers, or between people like brothers
senses.definitionCN: 兄弟之间或情同手足者之间的情感与忠诚
senses.example: Their brotherhood survived years of rivalry.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的竞争没有伤及他们的手足之情。
senses.why: The suffix -hood names a state, so the base word brother becomes the state of being brothers.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -hood 表状态，brother 由此变成「为兄弟」这一状态。

senses.title: Fellowship of all humanity
senses.definition: the ideal that all people are brothers and should treat one another as kin
senses.definitionCN: 人人皆兄弟、当以手足相待的理念
senses.example: The charter speaks of peace and the brotherhood of man.
senses.exampleCN: 章程倡导和平与人类一家。
senses.why: Kinship inside a family is stretched to cover the whole human family.
senses.whyCN: 家庭内的亲缘被放大，覆盖整个人类大家庭。

senses.title: An organized group
senses.definition: a society, union or order whose members see themselves as brothers
senses.definitionCN: 成员以兄弟相待的会社、工会或修会
senses.example: The brotherhood of monks rose before dawn to pray.
senses.exampleCN: 修会的弟兄们天不亮就起身祈祷。
senses.why: A state of fellowship easily becomes the body of people who share it.
senses.whyCN: 情谊的状态顺势转指共享这份情谊的人群实体。

intro.en: Brotherhood is a native English formation: brother plus the old suffix -hood.
intro.cn: brotherhood 是英语本土构词：brother 加古后缀 -hood。

items.en: a reconstructed root bhrater meant the male sibling.
items.cn: 重构词根 bhrater 指男性同胞。

items.en: brothor and the suffix -had formed broðorscipe and kin words.
items.cn: 古英语 brothor 与后缀 -had 构成亲缘类抽象词。

items.en: brotherhede meant the state of being a brother and a confraternity.
items.cn: 中古英语 brotherhede 兼指兄弟状态与弟兄会。

items.en: spelling settled as brotherhood; trade unions took the word for their societies.
items.cn: 拼法定型为 brotherhood，工会以其自称组织。

items.en: brotherhood spans family feeling, universal fellowship and organized societies.
items.cn: 如今 brotherhood 兼指手足之情、人类友爱与有组织的团体。

note.en: Brotherhood sits inside the -hood family and beside words for fellow groups.
note.cn: brotherhood 属 -hood 词族，并与表示同伴团体的词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 兄弟般的，与 brotherhood 同根

entries.definition: the bond or group of sisters
entries.definitionCN: 姐妹情谊；妇女团体，平行构词

entries.definition: the state of being a mother
entries.definitionCN: 母职；母性，同用 -hood 后缀

entries.definition: brotherhood; a society of men with shared aims
entries.definitionCN: 兄弟情谊；兄弟会，拉丁同义成分

entries.definition: a religious brotherhood or lay society

entries.definitionCN: 工会，与 brotherhood 的组织义重叠

normalIntro.en: Split it cleanly: brother plus hood, the state and body of brothers.
normalIntro.cn: 把词干净地拆开：brother 加 hood，兄弟的状态与团体。

normal.cn: sisterhood 与 brotherhood 完全对仗。

normal.en: Fraternity is the Latin twin of brotherhood.
normal.cn: fraternity 是 brotherhood 的拉丁孪生词。
行业兄弟会即早期工会。

normal.en: The brotherhood of man stretches kin to all.
normal.cn: the brotherhood of man 把亲缘扩展到所有人。

abstract.en: Feel arms lock shoulder to shoulder around you.
abstract.cn: 感受众人手臂搭肩围成的一圈。

abstract.en: See one oath passing down a line of men.
abstract.cn: 看见一句誓言沿队列传递。

abstract.en: Hear many footsteps keeping one rhythm.
abstract.cn: 听许多脚步踏成同一个节拍。

examples.en: A true brotherhood grew among the ship's crew.
examples.cn: 船员之间结成了真正的手足情谊。

examples.en: The lecture praised the brotherhood of all nations.
examples.cn: 演讲礼赞了万国一家的情谊。

examples.en: Railway brotherhoods fought for shorter hours.
examples.cn: 铁路工人兄弟会为缩短工时而斗争。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「布拉德厚的」——兄弟们围坐一桌，情谊像「布拉德」一样实在，像城墙一样「厚」。

root: brotherhood 由 brother 加古英语后缀 -hood（状态、身份）构成，属本土构词；词根上溯原始印欧语 bhrater（男性同胞），与拉丁语 frater 同源，fraternity 即其拉丁对应。

sensesIntro.en: The state of being brothers widens to all mankind, then hardens into an organized body.
sensesIntro.cn: 「为兄弟」的状态先放大到全人类，再凝结为有组织的团体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arms linked shoulder to shoulder in one circle.
core.cn: 核心意象：手臂相挽，围成一圈。

intro.en: The -hood suffix turns a kin noun into a state and then a group.
intro.cn: -hood 后缀把亲属名词变成状态，再变成群体。

latinIntro.en: The suffix is Germanic; the Latin kin word is frater.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀属日耳曼语族；拉丁语亲属词为 frater。

items.meaning: the state of being a child
the state of being a mother
